extracted.intended_audience: applicants and senior/key personnel preparing NIH grant biographical sketches (e.g., F99/K00 applicants, mentors, and other significant contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare an NIH-format Biographical Sketch for senior/key personnel and other significant contributors for an NIH grant application, following the template and page limits (used here for an F99/K00 application).

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall biosketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided NIH biosketch format for each person and keep the entire biosketch to five pages or fewer. Follow section order and headings as shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: eRA Commons user name / credential
rubrics_metrics.description: eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login):
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the individual's eRA Commons username or other credential as part of the biosketch header information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Position title
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the person's current position title (e.g., Graduate Student, Professor, Associate Professor).

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training entries and ordering
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a table of education/training entries with columns: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), Start Date MM/YYYY, Completion Date MM/YYYY, FIELD OF STUDY. Begin with baccalaureate and proceed chronologically (baccalaureate → post‑graduate → postdoctoral/residency), adding or deleting rows as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personal Statement (Section A)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise narrative describing long-term research interests, relevant research experience and contributions to date, specific qualifications for the proposed role (e.g., mentoring, skills, prior studies), and how the proposed training/support will advance the applicant's development. Examples in the document show describing past research projects, leadership roles in studies, publications, and how the sponsor/plan will prepare the applicant for independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Positions and Honors (Section B)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List professional positions with dates (professional positions / chronology) and academic/professional honors. Include service roles (e.g., reviewer, editorial board memberships) and awards. Present positions chronologically and include relevant institutional affiliations and dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contributions to Science (Section C)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe the candidate's major contribution areas to science with a brief narrative for each area and list representative publications. Number and label contribution areas (e.g., I. Social Isolation and Loneliness; II. Mobile Health (mHealth) Interventions). For each area include a short description of the work's significance and selected citations (full citations, DOIs/links when available).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Support and Scholastic Performance (Section D)
rubrics_metrics.description: D. Research Support and Scholastic Performance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List Ongoing Research Support (explicitly label "Ongoing Research Support" and either list projects or state 'None') and Completed Research Support. For each grant include the funding source (e.g., NIH R01/R21), project title/aims, dates, the individual's role (e.g., Consultant, PI), and a brief description of study purpose and design when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Profile / Senior/Key Person required contact and role fields
rubrics_metrics.description: PROFILE - Senior/Key Person (fields shown: Prefix, First Name*, Middle Name, Last Name*, Suffix, Position/Title*, Organization Name*, Department, Division, Street1*, Street2, City*, County, State*, Province, Country*, Zip / Postal Code*, Phone Number*, E-Mail*, Credential, e.g., agency login:, Project Role*: Other (Specify), Degree Type:, Degree Year:, Other Project Role Category: Co-Sponsor)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When completing the senior/key person profile in the application system include all required contact and role fields marked with an asterisk. Provide full mailing address, phone, email, degree type and year, project role and any other project role categories. Ensure consistency between profile entries and biosketch content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment of biosketch and current & pending support
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach Biographical Sketch*: File Name:  Attach Current & Pending Support: File Name:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Upload the biosketch file (per the five-page limit) and a separate Current & Pending Support document where required. Use the designated attachment fields in the application interface and ensure file names and formats meet agency requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of examples and narrative detail to demonstrate fit and expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal statements and contributions include narrative examples (e.g., description of prior studies, pilot projects, pilot funding, mentorship experience, publications) demonstrating qualifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use concrete examples—published papers, funded projects, pilot work, mentoring outcomes—to show relevance and preparedness for the proposed project or training. Link described contributions to the proposed role (e.g., how mentorship or prior trials prepare the person to support the applicant).
